x01-one-way.observed_description: A plain cream paper ticket on a grey stone counter with one black arrow pointing right.
x01-one-way.note: Usable: a one-way ticket reads at 180 px and in the 4:5 crop; no text.

x02-round-trip.observed_description: A plain cream paper ticket on a grey stone counter with one black two-headed arrow pointing left and right.
x02-round-trip.note: Usable: a round-trip ticket reads at 180 px and in the 4:5 crop; no text.

x03-sofia-buys.observed_description: Sofia in her blue blazer takes a paper ticket from a smiling clerk in a grey shirt behind the glass of a station ticket window; a blurred sign hangs far behind.
x03-sofia-buys.note: Usable: buying a ticket reads at 180 px; the far sign is blurred and unreadable at runtime size.

x04-diego-buys.observed_description: Diego in his burgundy shirt with a grey backpack hands banknotes to a smiling clerk with a grey bun at a bus-station ticket window; buses blurred behind.
x04-diego-buys.note: Usable: buying a ticket reads at 180 px; far signs unreadable.
